params.message:
Remove the Vera page, and let the DID script take a role out

Vera, the review product, is gone.

- src/pages/vera.astro is removed; /vera and /vera/* redirect to the
  homepage (301), as the site does for other addresses that were public.
- The night hue for Vera leaves globals.css. The trust page names ProveML
  alone for checking claims. The README, the brand guide and the parked keys
  page stop presenting Vera as current; dated notes and the signed blog post
  stay as they are.
- scripts/did-webvh.mjs: --remove assigned to an undeclared `invocation`,
  so any version that removed a role threw a ReferenceError before it was
  built (no key was spent). The line goes, and the summary now names the
  roles a version removed. Rehearsed on a throwaway log with software keys:
  the old script fails on `rotate --remove`, the fixed one writes a version
  without the removed roles and verifies.

public/id/did.jsonl and did.json are untouched: taking #agent-vera and #vera
out of the identity is a signed version made on the YubiKeys.
